svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: About 14.8 m of 25.4 x 1.65 stainless tube in one length, no joints

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wind 11 turns on a 395 mm drum (mean diameter 420), 40 mm a turn,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so the tubes stand 14.6 apart. Use a turned wooden or steel former

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and wind slowly by hand; anneal nothing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Leave both ends on the right side, at the same point of the turn:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bend each out square to the coil, 150 long, so each tail ends 10

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside the shell. The lower tail is the inlet, the upper the outlet.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Overall: 445 across, 465 tall; tails 1016 and 1456 above the ground

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: when the coil sits on its brackets.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pressure test with water before fitting (see the safety stops).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: round within 5; no kinks or flats; both tails level.
